rules: Target Lock requires perception or a maintained valid sensory link.
Ability Theft during combat consumes the declared action unless a later mastery explicitly changes it.
Taking damage may force a concentration check.
A failed theft may alert the target through pain, suppression, telemetry, or instinct.
Stat Siphon cannot reduce a target below biologically viable minima through ordinary use.
HP Siphon transfers vitality but does not erase Jack's structural injuries.
CM Siphon efficiency and overcharge limits still apply in combat.
concentration_check: d20 + Will modifier + Steal mastery versus DC 10 or half incoming damage, whichever is higher
